question: How often does a CPU head on headline and teaser pick the same direction (up or down) as Clef's stored reading of the story, out of fold?
one_change: train a sparse logistic head on Clef's stored direction for the 1736 engine stories instead of having no direction head

baseline.model: always answering the more common direction

prediction.metric: out-of-fold direction accuracy on headline plus first two sentences
prediction.why: about 1400 stories carry a direction and 69 percent are up; text heads on a few hundred to a thousand examples usually add 5 to 12 points over the majority; the headline carries the direction of the change less often than the full text, so the lower view is expected near the low end
